definitions.gloss: back side; rear part; the back
definitions.explanation: The rear-facing part or side of an object, building, body, or area. Used to specify spatial orientation.

examples.japanese: {後|うし}ろ{側|がわ}に{回|まわ}る。
examples.english: To go around to the back.

examples.japanese: {車|くるま}の{後|うし}ろ{側|がわ}に{傷|きず}がある。
examples.english: There's a scratch on the back of the car.

examples.japanese: {会場|かいじょう}の{後|うし}ろ{側|がわ}の{席|せき}はまだ{空|あ}いている。
examples.english: The seats at the back of the venue are still available.

notes:
A compound of {後|うし}ろ (behind, back) and {側|がわ} (side). Part of the directional {側|がわ} series along with {前側|まえがわ} (front side), {右側|みぎがわ} (right side), {左側|ひだりがわ} (left side).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {後|うし}ろ{側|がわ}の{席|せき} — back seat
- {後|うし}ろ{側|がわ}から{見|み}る — to look from behind
- {建物|たてもの}の{後|うし}ろ{側|がわ} — the back of a building

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {背面|はいめん} — back surface, rear (more formal/technical)
- {裏側|うらがわ} — reverse side, back side (for flat objects, or hidden side)
- {前側|まえがわ} — front side (antonym)
